entries.name: MC146818 RTC
entries.description: Real-time clock with battery-backed RAM: fourteen clock and status registers followed by general purpose bytes, reached through an index register and a data register.
entries.behaviour: A write to the address register selects one of 64 bytes, and the data register then reads or writes the selected byte. The first fourteen are the clock.

sources.cites: The first fourteen bytes are dedicated to the MC146818 chip clock functions
